earn_note: *Housing Rewards isn't a flat rate. It scales with your everyday spend: up to 1.25x on rent or mortgage, based on how much of that payment your card spend covers in the same billing cycle (25% of the payment = 0.5x, 50% = 0.75x, 75% = 1x, 100%+ = 1.25x; below 25% still earns a flat 250 points if you make a housing payment). Terms and conditions apply. There's no 5-transaction monthly minimum, unlike the original Bilt Card. Accounts opened before January 1, 2027 can instead pick the Flexible Bilt Cash option: 4% back in Bilt Cash on everyday spend, with up to 1x on housing unlocked at $3 of Bilt Cash per 100 points. That option ends at the first card anniversary on or after January 1, 2027 unless you make a Legacy Election. The restaurant bonus varies by location and is shown in the Bilt app at checkout, and up to 4x is just the ceiling, not a flat rate.

redemption_options.method: Transfer to airline/hotel partners (19 airlines, 7 hotels, mostly 1:1)
Book travel directly through the Bilt Travel Portal
Statement credit, rent credit, or Lyft rides

points.note: The Points Guy values Bilt Points at 2.2¢ each, a figure Bilt quotes on its own card page, but that ceiling only applies to well-chosen airline and hotel transfers. Points are worth 1.25¢ in the Bilt Travel Portal. Bilt publishes no fixed rate for statement credits or rent; it shows the value when you redeem, so the 1¢ here is our estimate.

transfer_partners.highlight: 19 airline and 7 hotel partners, plus Amtrak at 2:1. Almost all are 1:1 (Accor Live Limitless is 3:2, I Prefer is 1:2): Hyatt, Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Wyndham, and I Prefer on the hotel side; United, JetBlue, Air France/KLM, Emirates, Cathay Pacific, and Southwest among the airlines.
transfer_partners.recent_changes: JetBlue TrueBlue was added at 1:1 on October 20, 2026, and Amtrak Guest Rewards at 2 Bilt Points to 1 Amtrak point on September 23, 2026, after Wyndham Rewards (March 25, 2026) and I Prefer Hotel Rewards (June 22, 2026). Spirit is no longer on Bilt's partner list. Separately, from Aug 5, 2026 Bilt members who hold a Qatar Airways Privilege Club card earn 3 Avios per $1 of rent paid through Bilt, up to $50,000/yr, instead of Bilt Points. That is a competing way to use Bilt for rent, not a change to this card.

partners.name: Accor Live Limitless (ALL)
partners.notes: 1,000 Bilt points convert to about 667 Accor points, the one below-1:1 airline/hotel ratio in the program.

partners.name: Marriott Bonvoy
partners.notes: Every 20,000 points converted in a single transaction adds 5,000 Bonvoy points, so 20,000 becomes 25,000.

partners.name: Preferred Hotels & Resorts I Prefer
partners.notes: Favorable reverse ratio: 1,000 Bilt points become 2,000 I Prefer points. Added as a transfer partner in June 2026.

protection_note: Secondary rental CDW, purchase assurance and cell phone protection on a $0-fee card. No trip cancellation, trip delay, extended warranty or luggage coverage. Those start at Obsidian.
rental_note: MasterRental is secondary, so it pays after your personal auto policy, and it is primary only if you have no other insurance or yours does not cover you abroad. Decline the counter's CDW and pay for the whole rental with this card. Trucks, full-size vans, motorcycles and antique vehicles are excluded.

services.name: No transaction fee on rent, mortgage, and HOA payments
services.detail: Pay housing costs through Bilt with no card-processing fee, even if your landlord's portal normally charges one. Funds are debited from a linked bank account within 24 hours, not your credit line.

timeline.text: From your first card anniversary on or after January 1, 2027, the Flexible Bilt Cash option ends, along with its 4% back in Bilt Cash on everyday spend, unless you make a Legacy Election first.
JetBlue TrueBlue joins as a 1:1 transfer partner.
Amtrak Guest Rewards joins as Bilt's first rail partner, at 2 Bilt Points to 1 Amtrak point.
Spirit drops off Bilt's transfer partner list.

Bilt Card 2.0 launches as a three-tier lineup (Blue/Obsidian/Palladium), replacing the original single Bilt Mastercard and removing its 5-transaction-per-month requirement to earn on rent. Column N.A. takes over as issuing bank from Wells Fargo; the old Wells Fargo card stopped working on Feb 6.
